development.title: DevCollab Hub
development.description: A collaborative platform for developers to connect and build products, enhanced with non-intrusive AIs to provide actionable insights. Features include rich developer profiles, project listings, and real-time chat, alongside AI-powered tools like (1.) Project audience analysis to help owners in analyzing the collective profiles of the interested users, highlighting potential gaps in expertise against the project's requirements, and offering strategic advice on how to build a balanced team. This feature provides an “Audience Summary,” identifies “Potential Gaps,” and offers “Actionable Advice.”; (2.) Guided chat conversations that compares the participants' profiles against the project/role context and suggests targeted questions, identifies points of alignment, and highlights potential gaps to discuss, ensuring a more productive dialogue., and (3.) An engagement coach AI system that operates at the engagement meta-level without reading content. Its capabilities include: • Detect stalled engagements (based on milestone inactivity). • Flag repeated revision requests as a potential mismatch. • Privately summarize completed outcomes for the developer. • Recommend the next type of advisor based on the developer’s engagement history Its role is to act as a private coach. Built with Next.js, Firebase, and Google AI (Genkit).

development.title: My Portfolio
development.description: A full-stack Next.js 14 portfolio featuring an AI Assistant (chatbot) and an AI Cover Letter Generator. Built with a server-centric App Router architecture, it uses Cloud Firestore for the blog, Upstash Redis for rate-limiting, and is secured by Firebase Authentication. Deployed on Google Cloud Run via Firebase App Hosting.

development.title: Datum – Cloud File Storage & Management
development.description: A modern cloud-based file storage and management platform built with Next.js and TypeScript. Supports folder navigation, file previews, and secure sharing, powered by a Firebase backend including Authentication, Firestore for database, and Cloud Storage for file buckets. It uses Zod for strict input validation and features a responsive UI built with shadcn/ui.

development.title: Truck HOS Planner — ELD & Route Compliance
development.description: A full-stack app that plans truck trips and enforces FMCSA hours-of-service rules while producing printable ELD (RODS) sheets.Backend: Django REST API with a rule-driven HOS engine implementing the 11-hour driving limit and 14-hour window, a required 30-minute break after 8 hours, rolling 70/8 and 60/7 weekly limits, a 34-hour restart and sleeper-berth split logic; routing uses OpenRouteService when configured with a haversine fallback, reverse geocoding uses Nominatim with caching.Frontend: React single-page app using Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles for mapping, auto-zoomed route fit, custom colored markers for Start Pickup and Dropoff, an interactive TripForm that accepts coordinates or lat/lng and an SVG ELD renderer that buckets events by day and shows remarks for each duty change.Exports: dom-to-image-more and jsPDF for PNG and multi-page PDF output.Includes admin models, environment-driven configuration, unit test skeletons and deployment notes for Render and Vercel.

development.title: Portfolio Platform
development.description: A full-stack portfolio showcase application. Built with React (Vite) for a fast, responsive frontend and Node.js/Express for the backend API. Supports secure authentication via Supabase, project creation, editing and dynamic image uploads in its Projects Management Dashboard, with real-time previews. Features a clean UI powered by shadcn/ui and TailwindCSS, with optimized workflows for adding, updating and showcasing projects. Deployed on Render with environment-specific configurations for seamless integration between frontend and backend services.

development.title: Teekit- Ticketing App
development.description: A full-stack ticket management system built with Next.js 14, MongoDB, and Clerk for secure authentication. Features include creating, editing, viewing, and deleting tickets, dynamic dashboard filtering and a responsive UI.

development.title: TravelBoom – Travel Recommendation Platform
development.description: A functional travel recommendation website built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. Fetches destination data from a JSON file using the Fetch API and provides interactive search for countries, beaches, temples, and African destinations.

datascience.title: Clustering of the Daily Energy Consumption Load Profiles
datascience.description: K-Means clustering on daily building energy usage (Building Genome Project) to identify consumption patterns, detect anomalies, and enhance demand forecasting. Presented through a Streamlit web app.

datascience.title: Electricity Prediction via K-Nearest Neighbor Regression
datascience.description: Forecasted electricity consumption from enrgy load patterns using K-NN regression built from weather and historical energy data. Integrated into an interactive Streamlit interface for exploration.

datascience.title: Thermal Comfort & Energy Forecasting with XGBoost
datascience.description: Used XGBoost models to forecast building occupants’ thermal comfort and energy usage. Delivered results through a Streamlit app and detailed exploratory data analysis.

datascience.title: Heavy Equipment Data Scraping, Cleaning & Consolidation
datascience.description: Developed a suite of automated scrapers for  heavy equipment to extract specifications and features from websites, APIs and auction listings. Implemented dynamic schema creation for varying equipment categories, stored data in SQLite and built cleaning pipelines to normalize units (imperial to metric), handle missing values and export cleaned datasets for analysis. Consolidated all scripts into a main runner for streamlined execution. Currently creating a system that enables automated updates, error handling and database management functions. Use cases will include market analysis, inventory management and cost estimation, with future plans for machine learning integration, API development and dashboards.

datascience.title: Job Posting Data Extraction, Exploratory Data Analysis and Visualization
datascience.description: Automated extraction and analysis of job posting data using Beautiful Soup for ETL and visualization, uncovering hiring trends and requirements in the job market.

datascience.title: Exploratory Data Analysis on Online Store Operations
datascience.description: Performed EDA to uncover patterns, outliers, and correlations to optimize online store operations and drive data-informed recommendations for improving customer satisfaction.

civil.title: Hybrid 3-Bedroom Maisonette Design & Supervision
civil.description:
Worked with Ujenzi Bora in leading the structural design of a hybrid 3-bedroom maisonette integrating modular steel shipping containers (one 40-ft and one 20-ft) with reinforced concrete structural framing for the foundation, slabs, and selected load-bearing walls.

Applied structural steel framing in targeted areas to optimize load paths, accommodate architectural openings and improve construction efficiency.

Conducted structural analysis and design using Prota, Prokon, AutoCAD and Revit to validate performance under gravity and lateral loads in line with relevant standards.

Prepared detailed construction drawings, reinforcement schedules, and supervised site execution to ensure quality control and compliance with design intent.

Engaged in technical communication with the client, presenting design alternatives, clarifying sequencing of container integration and addressing modifications during execution.

Delivered a cost-efficient and durable solution that harmonized conventional RC construction with modular containers and steel framing for sustainability and long-term performance.

civil.title: Engineering and Construction Management
civil.description:
Worked with Sobetra on major infrastructure projects including Nandi–Timboroa–Miteitei–Kopere road, water distribution networks in coastal Kenya, Konza Technopolis infrastructure Project and Upgrading of the Achwa Bridge Crossing in Uganda.

Responsibilities included auditing Interim Payment Certificates to ensure accuracy, analyzing machine costs, and standardizing reporting templates for better data management.

Supported project delivery through detailed analysis, design and cost evaluations. Negotiated with suppliers and subcontractors on service and products supplies to mainatain financial oversight.

Coordinated between multiple sites and headquarters helping centralize project information and established structured governance for budgeting and performance reporting.

Assisted the Project Management Office in developing policies, maintaining risk registers and capturing lessons learned to guide future projects.

Regularly provided technical assistance, report writing and mentorship collaboration with senior management.

civil.title: Highway Infrastructure Development
civil.description: Worked with China Wu Yi where I contributed to the structural and civil works of the James Gichuru–Rironi Junction (A104) highway project, including supervision, structural detailing and review of the design analysis of drainage systems, retaining walls, and road infrastructure. Drafted shop drawings for four bridges covering superstructures, girders, and formwork along a 25 km stretch. Coordinated between contractors and consultants to ensure accurate interpretation of drawings on site. Prepared and reviewed technical clarifications with the chief engineer, while also guiding foreign contractors in fostering positive consultant–client relations for smooth project execution.

civil.title: Residential Development
civil.description: Comprehensive structural analysis, design, detailing and construction supervision of 12 floor and a 5- floor residential Apartments in Kileleshwa and Umoja, Nairobi, Kenya;- Under Struhig Africa ltd.

civil.title: Commercial Development
civil.description: Design review and structural detailing of the Kenya Women Microfinace Bank construction project in Nairobi, Kenya;- Under Struhig Africa ltd.
